11.
All debts and liabilities of the Society existing on
the day immediately preceding the date of commencement
of  this  Act,  shall  be  paid  by  the  Corporation  hereby
constituted  and  all  debts  due  to  and  subscriptions  and
contributions  payable  to  the  Society  existing  on  that  day
shall be paid to the Corporation for the purposes of this Act.
